sources.anchor: arXiv v3, 9 November 2023; checked 29 September 2026: Theorem 1, Corollary 1, Table I and Appendix B (B14–B19, B28).

Constants retain function/derivative/nonzero-mass assumptions. Sparse variants require supplied coefficients and Hamming-weight bounds. Amplification also charges reflections and inverses.

(18) bounds normalized-block error delta, corresponding to total-scale times delta in the unscaled-operator convention.
